qa_pairs.question: What type of data is presented graphically in the "Task Statistics" section of the Metrix portal, showing an average over recent days?
qa_pairs.answer: In the "Task Statistics" section of the Metrix portal, an average of CPU core and memory usage from the last few days is displayed in a graphical format.

qa_pairs.question: After viewing current resource utilization in the Metrix portal's "Task Statistics" section, what information is presented next?
qa_pairs.answer: Following the display of current resource utilization, users can access a graph showing the average CPU core and memory usage over the last few days in the Metrix portal's "Task Statistics" section.
